release_rulings.ruling: Experimental toolkit publication is expressly allowed without superiority scores. Four-arm missing runs may be NOT_RUN; no outperforming-Codex claim. This does not waive independent holdout, safety or full stable-core gates.

11.4 one held-out case and G13 three unseen combinations are cumulative constraints, not interchangeable minima. Plan at least three separately controlled hidden combinations and satisfy full-game sample composition; no agent-authored hidden fixtures count.
Allowed trusted development, public regression and same-host review cannot confer untrusted sandbox assurance, manual aesthetic approval, target-player performance or external independent evaluation.

Do all feasible implementation/evidence and publish accurate PARTIAL experimental core if authorized, preserving blocked stable gates. A v1.0 stable/completed Phase11 claim or Stable-v1 Phase12 prerequisite remains unsatisfied until those gates pass; no silent redefinition to proceed.

Single vs sequential, inspector-off and generic-worker ablations may be development evaluation modes. Actual concurrency/native delegation requires real measured host support and explicit labels; unavailable cases remain NOT_RUN/BLOCKED, no proxy speedup claims.

Static inspection may read an original project and emit stdout or an external artifact. It must never initialize/write its root or launch Unity against it, including logging/caches. Full original inventory hashes include .meta and reject unverifiable scope.

The user has expressly requested phasewise continuation through17, satisfying permission to continue after a phase report; this does not itself prove or erase Stable-v1 entry gates or independent release requirements. Record continuation as development where prerequisites remain unqualified rather than asserting gates passed.
